title: Chained Soldier — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Nobody designed the part of Chained Soldier you experience — it was inherited. Chained Soldier, known in Japan as Mato Seihei no Slave (Japanese: 魔都精兵のスレイブ, Hepburn: Mato Seihei no Sureibu; lit. 'Slave of the Magic Capital's Elite Troops'), is a Japanese web manga series written by Takahiro and illustrated by Yohei Takemura. The series is set in a near-future Japan where portals to a dangerous dimension, called Mato, have appeared across the country.

The feeling that Chained Soldier means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. Commander of the Mato Defense Force's 2nd Squad, Mira is a former delinquent and gang leader from Okinawa. She is bold and aggressive, with ambitions to become the MDF's Supreme Commander, and views Kyouka Uzen as her primary rival.
